newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS upgrades Nestle earnings view.
newsitem.headline: UBS upgrades Nestle earnings view.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland said it had upgraded its earning estimates for Nestle SA and reaffirmed its long-term "buy" recommendation for the world's largest food company.

"In international comparison Nestle shows a more favourable valuation than Unilever (P/E for 1998 of 16.7)," UBS said in a research study before Nestle is expected to release 1996 sales figures on January 21.
"Volume growth at an average 3.7 percent a year for the next three years should be higher than at Unilever (+2.5 percent) and Danone (+0.5 percent)."
"Because we expect rising operating margins and more favourable exchange rate conditions again from 1997, we are raising our EPS estimates slightly," it said.
It expected 1996 sales to rise to around 60.55 billion Swiss francs, a gain of 7.2 percent.
